reason: 该插件的主要用户价值在于提供 DeepSeek Harness 的“只读安全审计”会话能力：通过预设和命令控制进入/退出审计状态，并在工具层做执行限制与可控的报告输出选择。证据来自 README 对审计模式、工具白名单、强制交付选择和报告写入审批流程的说明，以及 package.json 中的插件装载配置。总体属于面向会话流程自动化与受控审计执行的插件功能，而非代码生成或文档处理工具。

summaries.zh: 只读安全审计插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供专用审计模式，在只读策略下读取分析项目，并在用户选择后允许生成一次审计报告文件。
summaries.en: The Read-only Security Audit plugin adds a dedicated audit mode to DeepSeek Harness for read-only code and configuration checks, with a user-approved single-step option to write a report file.

capabilities: Enables a read-only audit session preset for DeepSeek Harness
Hooks tool execution to block non-allowlisted tool calls during audit mode
Adds mandatory report-delivery selection before auditing starts
Provides per-session slash commands to toggle or check read-only audit status
Supports single approved report-file write with immediate return to read-only mode
Installs as a harness plugin bundle and preset entry

reasons.code: README states the plugin provides a dedicated "readonly-audit" preset mode and slash commands `/readonly-audit on|off|status` for session control.
README describes an outer `tools/pre-execute` allowlist gate that rejects non-reader tools and an explicit one-shot approved mutation path.
README requires report delivery choice (chat or file) before audit reading begins, and requires user approval for writing `SECURITY_AUDIT_REPORT.md`.
package.json defines a plugin package entry (`main: lib/index.js`) and a DSH bundle patch, indicating integration as a loadable runtime extension.
Repository metadata is public, not archived, and has immutable commit evidence, plus published files including lib/build/test tooling and preset/scripts.
